summary: dellemc.enterprise_sonic's sonic_aaa replaced the deleted group and local attributes with default_auth, allowing ordered login authentication.
questions: sonic_aaa rejects group and local, what do I use?
How do I set login authentication order with sonic_aaa?

answer_card.title: sonic_aaa: use default_auth
answer_card.answer_md: In `dellemc.enterprise_sonic.sonic_aaa`, the `group` and `local` attributes were removed. Use **`default_auth`**, which takes an ordered list of login authentication methods.
